name: How do custom cabinets compare to stock or semi-custom options?

mainEntity.name: How do custom cabinets compare to stock or semi-custom options?

acceptedAnswer.text: Custom cabinetry is designed and built to the exact dimensions, architectural features, and storage needs of your specific room. Stock cabinets come pre-manufactured in standard three-inch width increments with limited finish selections, while semi-custom options offer standard sizing with adjustable door styles and depth modifications. Custom cabinets eliminate filler strips, maximize wall-to-wall space, and accommodate ceiling-height storage or awkward corners. The tradeoff is that fully custom work requires longer lead times and higher investment than selecting modular stock boxes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom cabinets are built to exact room dimensions and functional preferences, while stock cabinets use fixed, standardized dimensions with limited finish choices.
